Hi Olivia / Kyle —

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the thoughtful questions from procurement and security. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can move toward contract: 

- Procurement path: Olivia mentioned Acme prefers purchase orders (POs) for enterprise deals, with vendor onboarding ~2–4 weeks once paperwork is in. Please confirm if a PO and vendor setup is the primary route or if a card payment is acceptable for a pilot.
- Security/compliance: Kyle asked for SOC 2 Type II report, standard DPA, and answers to a short security questionnaire. We can provide the SOC 2 redacted report and our standard DPA; for questionnaire items we can either fill directly or work with your security team on a shared doc.
- Commercial: we discussed a 12-month committed Dedicated tier vs hosted API pilot. For contracting: we can provide SOW + MSA + invoice.

Attachments I'm including here: redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf, DPA_redwood_inference_v1.2.pdf, and a draft SOW.

Next steps proposed:
1) Olivia — confirm PO vs card and target vendor onboarding date.
2) Kyle / security — confirm preferred questionnaire format (spreadsheet vs DocuSign/OneTrust) and any mandatory evidence types.
3) I’ll loop in Legal (Monica) if you want redlines on the DPA/MSA.

If helpful, I can also put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) with dates.

Thanks,

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for sending those docs. A few notes from Procurement & Security: 

- Procurement: our preference is to use a PO for contract value > $50k. This will require vendor onboarding (W-9, vendor profile, banking details). Target onboarding time is ~2–3 weeks once we have the MSA + invoice. Card payment could be used for an initial $10k pilot, but we'd prefer PO for the committed rollout.
- Security: we need a current SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine), the DPA, and completed answers to our security questionnaire. We're generally OK with your DPA but Legal will need to review — please send the editable DPA (docx) if possible.
- Marketplace: we are also evaluating procurement via our cloud marketplace (GCP Marketplace). Is Redwood listed? If so, that could speed procurement — can you confirm?

Action items for your side: please provide an editable DPA, confirm whether Redwood is on GCP Marketplace, and send an invoice example we can use for the PO.

Thanks,
Olivia

- Marketplace: Redwood is live on GCP Marketplace in limited regions; I’m confirming listing details with our partnerships team and will update you by EOD. If marketplace procurement will be the path, that often shortens the vendor onboarding steps.
